result.reason: The edit appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors and removes at-will revocability while preserving the Services limitation and use restrictions. However, it does not satisfy the playbook because it permits licence termination whenever the Agreement or applicable attachment expires or terminates, rather than only for uncured material breach for subscription licences, does not make any paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable, and provides no transfer right to successors, including in an M&A transaction. The margin comment does not cure these operative omissions.
